The next three commands deal with the, so-called, MD-reduction procedure developed in . Particularly, according to , a 2-letter or 2-state invertible reversible automaton generates a finite group if and only if the MD-reduction procedure terminates with the trivial automaton. In this case an automaton is called MD-trivial.
